alignedSenses.exampleZh: 这幅小画卖出了令人意外的高价。

alignedSenses.en: To go somewhere, get something, and bring it back.

chineseMeanings.text: 拍卖商

englishDefinitions.text: an agent who conducts an auction

alignedSenses.en: A person who leads an auction and sells items to the highest bidder.
alignedSenses.zh: 拍卖师；主持拍卖并将物品卖给最高出价者的人。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: The auctioneer raised the hammer as the bidding ended.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 竞价结束时，拍卖师举起了拍卖槌。

sell at an auction

englishDefinitions.text: n an area where merchandise (such as cars) can be displayed

alignedSenses.en: Rooms where objects are sold at auction.
alignedSenses.zh: 拍卖场；拍卖室（saleroom 的复数）。

alignedSenses.exampleZh: 收藏家挤满拍卖场，竞拍稀有画作。

chineseMeanings.text: 出价

a formal proposal to buy at a specified price

ask for or request earnestly

alignedSenses.en: An offer to pay a particular price for something at an auction.
alignedSenses.zh: 出价；拍卖时提出的价格。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: Her final bid was higher than anyone else's.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 她最后的出价比其他任何人都高。

alignedSenses.en: To offer a price for something, especially at an auction.
alignedSenses.exampleEn: Three collectors bid for the same painting.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 三位收藏家竞价购买同一幅画。

alignedSenses.en: An attempt to achieve or obtain something.
alignedSenses.exampleEn: The city launched a bid to host the event.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 这座城市开始争取主办这项活动。

alignedSenses.en: an authoritative direction or instruction to do something
an attempt to get something

alignedSenses.en: propose a payment

chineseMeanings.text: 同时代的人

alignedSenses.exampleEn: The museum has a large collection of contemporary art.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 这家博物馆收藏了大量当代艺术作品。

alignedSenses.en: Living or happening during the same period.
alignedSenses.zh: 同时代的；发生在同一时期的。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: The two writers were contemporary with each other.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 这两位作家生活在同一时代。

alignedSenses.en: A person who lived at the same time as someone else.
alignedSenses.exampleEn: His contemporaries admired his bold style.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 与他同时代的人欣赏他大胆的风格。

alignedSenses.en: occurring in the same period of time
alignedSenses.zh: 同时代+的；同时期+的；现代+的
alignedSenses.exampleEn: a rise in interest rates is often contemporaneous with an increase in inflation

alignedSenses.en: A legal situation in which a person or business cannot pay its debts.
alignedSenses.zh: 破产；因无法偿还债务而进入的法律状态。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: Falling sales pushed the company toward bankruptcy.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 销售额下降使这家公司濒临破产。

alignedSenses.en: A serious lack of useful ideas, values, or ability.
alignedSenses.zh: （思想、道德等的）彻底匮乏或败坏。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: The report exposed the moral bankruptcy of the decision.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 这份报告揭露了这一决定在道德上的彻底败坏。

alignedSenses.en: a state of complete lack of some abstract property
alignedSenses.exampleEn: spiritual bankruptcy

alignedSenses.en: inability to discharge all your debts as they come due

make excessively or undesirably hot

alignedSenses.en: Growing or becoming active too quickly to remain stable.
alignedSenses.zh: （经济、市场等）过热的；发展过快而不稳定的。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: Prices rose rapidly in the overheated art market.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 在过热的艺术品市场中，价格迅速上涨。

alignedSenses.en: Having become hotter than is safe or suitable.
alignedSenses.exampleEn: The overheated engine had to be switched off.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 过热的发动机必须关闭。

alignedSenses.en: make excessively or undesirably hot

chineseMeanings.text: 动力, 动量

englishDefinitions.text: an impelling force or strength

alignedSenses.zh: 势头；使活动持续或发展的动力。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: The campaign gained momentum after its first success.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 首次取得成功后，这项活动的势头增强了。

alignedSenses.en: In physics, mass multiplied by velocity.
alignedSenses.zh: 动量；物体质量与速度的乘积。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: A moving truck has more momentum than a bicycle at the same speed.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 在速度相同时，行驶中的卡车比自行车有更大的动量。

alignedSenses.en: an impelling force or strength

alignedSenses.en: To promise that something will happen or be true.
alignedSenses.zh: 保证；担保某事会发生或属实。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: The seller guarantees that the painting is genuine.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 卖家保证这幅画是真品。

alignedSenses.en: A promise to repair or replace a product if it fails within a stated period.
alignedSenses.exampleEn: The camera comes with a two-year guarantee.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 这台相机附带两年的保修承诺。

alignedSenses.exampleEn: Prices changed bewilderingly from one auction to the next.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 价格在一场场拍卖之间变化得令人费解。

chineseMeanings.text: (尤指经济方面的)衰退, 下降趋势

alignedSenses.exampleEn: The economic downturn reduced demand for expensive art.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 经济衰退降低了人们对昂贵艺术品的需求。

alignedSenses.en: To think or believe that something is true.
alignedSenses.exampleEn: I reckon the market will recover slowly.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 我认为市场会缓慢复苏。

alignedSenses.en: To calculate an amount or estimate a number.
alignedSenses.exampleEn: They reckoned the total cost at about a million dollars.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 他们估算总费用约为一百万美元。

alignedSenses.en: To expect or depend on something; used as 'reckon on'.
alignedSenses.zh: 指望；预期（常用 reckon on）。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: We cannot reckon on prices staying this high.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 我们不能指望价格一直维持这么高。

alignedSenses.zh: 印象派画家；以光线和即时视觉印象为重点的艺术家。

alignedSenses.exampleZh: 这位印象派画家描绘了变化光线中的河流。

alignedSenses.en: A performer who imitates other people's voices and manner.
alignedSenses.zh: 模仿他人声音和举止的表演者。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: The impressionist copied the actor's voice perfectly.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 这位模仿演员把那位演员的声音模仿得惟妙惟肖。

alignedSenses.exampleZh: 太阳能板在白天产生电力。

tumor.

alignedSenses.zh: 波动的；不稳定的（较少使用的形容词）。

(psychoanalysis) the conscious mind

alignedSenses.zh: 自我；个人对自身及自身重要性的认识。

alignedSenses.exampleZh: 赢得这场拍卖增强了他的自我满足感。

alignedSenses.exampleEn: Her large ego made it difficult to accept criticism.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 她过于自负，因此很难接受批评。

alignedSenses.zh: （价格、销量等的）暴跌；不景气；萧条。

alignedSenses.exampleZh: 对昂贵画作的需求骤降。

alignedSenses.exampleZh: 长途旅行后，他无力地瘫坐在椅子上。

alignedSenses.zh: 贪婪；对金钱或财物的过度欲望。
alignedSenses.exampleEn: Greed led the buyer to take unnecessary risks.
alignedSenses.exampleZh: 贪婪使这位买家承担了不必要的风险。

alignedSenses.zh: 贪吃；对某种享受的过度欲望。

alignedSenses.exampleZh: 出于贪吃，他拿了超过自己能吃完的蛋糕。

alignedSenses.exampleZh: 画廊会把这幅画送到你家。

alignedSenses.exampleZh: 这位社会学家向一大群学生发表了演说。

alignedSenses.zh: 着手解决；处理；应对问题。

englishDefinitions.text: In the most general sense, indicating that in consideration
of, in view of, or with reference to, which anything is done or takes
place.
Indicating the antecedent cause or occasion of an action;
the motive or inducement accompanying and prompting to an act or state;
the reason of anything; that on account of which a thing is or is done.
Indicating the remoter and indirect object of an act; the
end or final cause with reference to which anything is, acts, serves,
or is done.
Indicating that in favor of which, or in promoting which,
anything is, or is done; hence, in behalf of; in favor of; on the side
of; -- opposed to against.
Indicating that toward which the action of anything is
directed, or the point toward which motion is made; /ntending to go to.
Indicating that on place of or instead of which anything
acts or serves, or that to which a substitute, an equivalent, a
compensation, or the like, is offered or made; instead of, or place of.
Indicating that in the character of or as being which
anything is regarded or treated; to be, or as being.
Indicating that instead of which something else controls in
the performing of an action, or that in spite of which anything is
done, occurs, or is; hence, equivalent to notwithstanding, in spite of;
-- generally followed by all, aught, anything, etc.
Indicating the space or time through which an action or
state extends; hence, during; in or through the space or time of.
Indicating that in prevention of which, or through fear of
which, anything is done.
Because; by reason that; for that; indicating, in Old
English, the reason of anything.
Since; because; introducing a reason of something before
advanced, a cause, motive, explanation, justification, or the like, of
an action related or a statement made. It is logically nearly
equivalent to since, or because, but connects less closely, and is
sometimes used as a very general introduction to something suggested by
what has gone before.
One who takes, or that which is said on, the affrimative side;
that which is said in favor of some one or something; -- the antithesis
of against, and commonly used in connection with it.
